answer: Every claim climbs the ferrous of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the jetty re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, published publicly on failure, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Reaching the vertex of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
